minimumInterfaceCorrection.problemStatement: The source has two distinct issues: whole-sprite painter visibility exposes native submerged entry geometry, and a real 0.005-world exterior transfer run gap exists between step1 and the platform boundary. Fixing only RGB or alpha edge treatment does not fix either native interface.
lockedDuringCorrection: Dock and entry ground roots and relative transform (0,-1.5,0).
Dock logical 3×3 footprint, one world unit per cell, registered camera/root and sourceScale.
Broad deck walking surface near measured z0.22, source maximum dock height0.25, clear entry passage width0.76, stable hut/submarine/cover placement.
No painted pixel patches, target-plane cards, per-facing fitting, sprite nudges or changing neighbors without explicit coordinated scope.

options.description: Keep the deck surface and entry design. Produce a connected-entry native visibility capture against the actual candidate deck as a real depth occluder, or remove only connected-variant entry geometry proven always buried. Preserve exposed caps/posts/tread surfaces and any genuinely visible slivers through deck grooves. Close the exterior 0.005-world transfer run gap by a small native entry-side contact extension to the deck plane.
options.coordinationRequired: Dock-entry editable connected variant/capture and its catalog consumer selection; entry-side source contact repair. Standalone entry capture remains independently valid.
options.minimumNativeChange: Small entry-side run closure; connected visibility derives from native geometry, not edited pixels. No floor walking height change is needed.
options.captureContract: Same physical scene and one capture contract for all N/E/S/W. A native holdout/object-isolation render may separate visible entry contribution while keeping deck depth; bind this variant to candidate deck geometry hash. Do not remove an entire buried tread based only on a bounding box: source floor through-grooves make some slivers potentially visible.
options.remainingProfile: The authored final rise from external flat step0.135 to deck0.22 is0.085. This may be retained as a declared stair transition if accepted; it is not a flat coplanar join and must be shown with human traversal/context.
options.acceptance: No physical run gap; native and independent composition agree on which entry regions are visible. Clean projected RGB/alpha coverage under required filtering.

options.description: Rebuild the local entry/deck landing as an actual stair channel or a corrected final stair rise so that exposed tread geometry and the supporting deck form one coherent native structure. For example, a localized deck recess could reveal the inboard0.18 tread, while the landing transitions to0.22 and native entry contacts meet exactly.
options.coordinationRequired: Dock-floor local support profile and dock-entry step contact/source geometry; revised connected capture must be reviewed together.
options.contractChangeToFreeze: Only the bounded central entry landing region may depart from the old flat deck profile, explicitly recorded with cross-sections; global roots, footprint, broad walking height, max0.25height and width0.76clearance remain fixed.
options.editorFreedom: Editor chooses construction; this is a feasibility option, not a prescribed mesh recipe. Maintain stairs/landing use, avoid an unintended dip, protruding rim or unsupported tread.
options.acceptance: Watertight or intentionally overlapping continuous native support through the whole transfer; a logical human reaches the deck without visual float/snag. Independent sprites must show that same accepted structural arrangement.

options.description: A floor-only recess below the source0.18 tread could expose it natively and reduce painter-order disagreement, but it changes the local walking profile and cannot fill the exterior gap while staying within floor y>=-1.5. Pure floor material/edge improvements leave the submerged-step discrepancy unchanged.
options.disposition: Not a complete seamless-join solution. Do not label it passing merely because it resembles the old published composition.
options.possibleUse: Only as an explicitly partial design study; not recommended for a final join-certified candidate.

minimumInterfaceCorrection.recommendedMinimum: Option A plus the native entry-side run closure is the smallest complete correction while retaining broad deck height and placements. It requires coordinated dock-entry work/capture authorization from the coordinator. If the user instead wants a redesigned staircase, freeze Option B’s bounded local profile before editing.
minimumInterfaceCorrection.preparationVerdict: No current source/candidate join certification. Root must select and freeze a sufficient native/capture correction before fresh editor construction. This judge has proposed options only and changed no source.
